Image Description Sheet
-----------------------

File Name: repo-header-a4.png
Format: PNG
Dimensions: 830 x 173 pixels

Short Description:
A banner image featuring the Openapi logo and the "API Made Simple" tagline on the left,
and an isometric laptop with floating dashboard windows on the right.

Purpose:
This image is intended to be used as a header/banner for the Openapi LLM Wiki README,
giving a professional and modern look to the project materials.
